_doc: Ability tree mechanics the build score counts (AbilityMechanics), by class and node name. The nodes' own damage numbers come from
their text (AbilityText: a hit with a spell, on the main attack, in place of a spell); this table says what the text cannot, as a
steady state over an ordinary fight, each with the assumption it makes (assume) so it can be measured in game and set better.
target: what the node's damage goes with: a spell's name, main (each main attack hit), summon (count of them, rate hits a second each,
out a share of the fight as summons are), periodic (the whole of it once every 'every' seconds), none (not counted).
count: hits or orbs in place of the text's; mult: chance, uptime or stack scaling on the node's damage; replace: the spell whose own
damage the node takes the place of; skip: the node's damage is not counted (its factors below still are).
addCount / scale: more of another node's hits or orbs, another node's damage times a factor.
damage / spell / main: build-wide factors on all damage, spells, the main attack; raw: raw damage on every hit (spells and the
main attack); cost: factor on every spell's mana; manaPer5: mana back every 5 s; spells: factor per spell; cooldown: the shortest
time between two casts of a spell (s).

Collide.assume: half the Flying Kicks throw the mob into a wall

Air Shout.assume: the projectile hits one target all 3 times

Reverberance.assume: +2 hits and +40% a hit: 5 x 115% over 3 x 75%

Counter.assume: hit back once every 3 s (2 s cooldown per enemy)

Generalist.assume: three different spells in turn: every fourth costs 1 mana

Harmony.assume: 4 Harmony on average with Generalist kept going: +4% each

Discombobulate.assume: 40 Discombobulated on the target on average: +3 damage each

Pressure.assume: a quarter of the casts are Generalist's enhanced ones

Bak'al's Grasp.assume: 40% Corrupted on average: +4 raw damage per 2%

Enraged Blow.assume: 40% Corrupted: +1.5% damage per 1%, at its +55% cap

Bloodlust.assume: leaving Corrupted every 20 s at 40%: +5% per 1%

Armour Breaker.assume: +30% for 12 s of every 16 s, the boost not always fresh

Final Crush.assume: the last hit of Bash is about half its damage: +60% on it

Blood Pact.assume: spells paid in health when the mana runs out: about 10 more mana a second of casts

Bloodied Armory.assume: a blood swipe on 3 main attacks in 10 (Blood Pact paying)

Flaming Uppercut.assume: the burn runs most of its 3 s before the mob dies

Ophanim.assume: 2 orbs, each hitting about 1.5 times a second (they attack with your main attacks), out as summons are; Meteor's own damage is gone

Lightweaver.assume: 3 orbs, each hitting once a second while out

Crystallize.assume: a shatter every 15 s (7 Crystallized a Lightweaver hit)

Sunshower.assume: most Heals have an enemy in reach

Thunderstorm.assume: the strike lands on the target most of the time

Rift Rupture.assume: once a Dimensional Tear (8 s cooldown)

Etheric Slash.assume: most Teleports pass through the target

Arcane Transfer.assume: about 2 enemies hit per damage spell: the bank comes back as 3 mana a second

Arcane Power.assume: +8 more mana a damage spell's enemy

Manastorm.assume: above 100 mana half the time: +5 mana a cast

Chaos Explosion.assume: the last 3 spells again about every 20 s

Pyrokinesis.assume: one main attack in 4 explodes (each time the bank reaches 30)

Induced Instability.assume: Unstable up a third of the time

Distortion.assume: 18 Distortion on average: +1 raw damage each

Meteor Shower.assume: one more Meteor at 20 Distortion, both 20% smaller

Paradox.assume: 25% of the mana spent comes back

Twain's Arc.assume: one main attack in 5 is a charged beam

Crepuscular Ray.assume: a levitating burst every 12 s (10 arrows hit one target)

Initiator.assume: +60% on one hit in a dozen

Buckshot.assume: the shield's last charge goes about every 10 s

Fierce Stomp.assume: half the Escapes land on the target

Courier's Edict.assume: half the waves reach the target

Marked.assume: 3 Marks kept on the target by Smoke Bomb: +7% each

Backstab.assume: half the Backstabs from behind (double damage)

Surprise Strike.assume: +80% on the first hit after Vanish, about an eighth of the damage

Shadow Dance.assume: +50% on the second hit after Vanish

Nightcloak Knives.assume: about 2 Knives out: 13% of the damage dealt each

Mirror Image.assume: the +30% bonus up a third of the time

Echo.assume: a third of the casts copied by 2 clones at -25%

Shurikens.assume: 3 shurikens on a main attack after each Dash, about one main attack in 10

Disappearing Act.assume: all Mirror Clones lost about every 20 s

Shadow Projection.assume: a clone thrown and detonated every 10 s

Nature's Jolt.assume: half the Hauls land near the target

Exploding Puppets.assume: a Puppet explodes as each one's 30 s runs out: 3 Puppets about every 10 s, one every 3 s

Frog Dance.assume: Haul with the Heretic mask half the time
